Actual Control UI rendered from the before/after source with a mocked Gateway and synthetic users and conversations—not a design mock or live deployment.

### Before

![Before: combined sidebar destinations and shared session pins](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5370b996-d274-4608-a5a2-e84c6b176d78)

### After

<details>
<summary>Collapsed rail and narrow drawer</summary>

The rail stays available when the desktop list is collapsed.

![Desktop with collapsed session list and retained personal rail](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1c5b142-f681-4568-9dcf-09eaea19a7de)

![Narrow navigation drawer with personal rail](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c476a39-b728-48e8-9da7-10b2099cbf42)

</details>

The captured interaction run exercised native person/dashboard/conversation drag, reorder/unpin, Mine/All, collapse, and narrow layout. Personal pin actions made no shared session-pinning mutations.

Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR separates Pages, Sessions, and Online into a compact sidebar rail with personal shortcuts and profile-synchronized navigation preferences. **Example:** Alex pins the Plugins page and collapses the desktop sidebar. - **Before:** Collapsing hides navigation, and session pin actions change shared session metadata. - **After:** The rail retains Alex’s shortcuts, and personal pin actions leave shared session metadata unchanged. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Approved user value, directly inspected browser evidence, and stable-upgrade coverage support landing; no actionable finding remains in the reviewed paths. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected actual Control UI browser captures showing the rail, collapse, narrow drawer, profileless fallback, and visible stable-outbox recovery; supplied interaction and upgrade results exercise the production UI with a mocked Gateway and synthetic identities. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Feature · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Destinations, conversations, and online people compete in one sidebar, and shared pins cannot express each person’s preferred navigation. **Reason:** The collaborator-authored change implements recorded owner direction and provides personal navigation through the existing persistence owner. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this approved, collaborator-authored feature open; current main still uses shared session pins, and I found no actionable defect in the reviewed changes. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `968087f45c5aab2f66857f3343c2e145addffb0d` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This is a feature request; current-main source confirms the shared pin behavior being replaced, and supplied browser evidence demonstrates the proposed navigation. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The implementation follows the approved design by reusing authenticated profile preferences, preserving browser-local fallback, and keeping personal shortcuts separate from shared session promotion and archive actions. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([`ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts:351`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/9cf7fc279c26cf3493b75e703aeadac6d0deb5ee/ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts#L351), [9cf7fc279c26](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9cf7fc279c26cf3493b75e703aeadac6d0deb5ee)) - **Profile write boundary:** Navigation writes recheck current ownership after reading preferences, rebase authored shortcut changes, and use expectedEntries through the existing authenticated users.prefs.set owner. ([`ui/src/app/server-prefs-profile-runtime.ts:112`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/968087f45c5aab2f66857f3343c2e145addffb0d/ui/src/app/server-prefs-profile-runtime.ts#L112), [968087f45c5a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/968087f45c5aab2f66857f3343c2e145addffb0d)) - **Stable pending-outbox compatibility:** The v2026.9.9 source confirms pending records lacked sidebarEntriesBase; adoption now captures only a valid same-profile pre-hydration baseline, while browser coverage exercises retained local choices, appearance draining, reload, and Unpin recovery. ([`ui/src/app/server-prefs.ts:148`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/968087f45c5aab2f66857f3343c2e145addffb0d/ui/src/app/server-prefs.ts#L148), [968087f45c5a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/968087f45c5aab2f66857f3343c2e145addffb0d)) - **Inspected browser evidence:** Inspected the supplied before/after sidebar images, collapsed rail, narrow drawer, profileless comparison, and stable-outbox recovery comparison; the actual Control UI uses synthetic data and a mocked Gateway, as disclosed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168325#issuecomment-6095274135 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168325#issuecomment-6101555259.
